statement: When you revise a record by inserting text beside existing text, read the committed diff at the edges of every hunk for collateral deletions. And when a pending-integration note is fulfilled, rewrite the note itself in the same commit. In cejel #558 an agent added a 'rerun on the synced candidate' paragraph by replacing an anchor string; the replacement dropped the anchor's own words, leaving a line that began ', almost all of it the two scans'. The same commit added the integrated read-failure class while the section above still listed two classes and still said the class must wait and be keyed on other evidence. Review pass 2 (round 7) caught both. Rules: after any scripted record edit, list every removed line of the diff and account for each; and treat a fulfilled 'until then' note as part of the change it describes.
